However, a closer look reveals that these platforms are not designed to be permanent solutions. They often have restrictions on the type of products that can be sold, and they take a significant cut of the revenue. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a base-layer solution that gives creators full control over their online store and the ability to sell any type of digital product without restrictions. This means that creators can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products without having to rely on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, like Stripe, have their own list of restricted countries. This means that creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan are still excluded from using these platforms. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be accessible to creators in all countries, regardless of the restrictions imposed by third-party platforms. When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a number of advantages over traditional platforms.
